turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother, and I have until 4:40. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. You haven't answered my question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it was entered?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm not here to advise you, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you have.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here, Hale? A teammate calls the parent before the mark goes in, not after. I'm still waiting to hear who decided on the zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for entering it before anyone called me, and that you tell me in writing who decided on it and whether Owen was heard first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with the zero withdrawn and an apology demanded, and nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing, because you never answered who decided on the zero or showed her a document.
What cost ground: "tell me how I should handle this", because asking her to do your job cost you respect and left her question unanswered.
Try next time: in your first turn, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her.
